network: offline; no learned separator admitted, installed NumPy/SciPy only

selection: explicit bounds fixed before retrieval; harmonic is always the broad query route, percussive retained for inspection; no best-stem search
default: original; promote only with complete paired retrieval gain and preservation/cost gates in the subsequently committed protocol
preservation: all prior audio, features, ledgers, manifests, predictions and reports retained; no B01 repair or held-out repeat
budget: fixed aggregate B02 namespace, caps in configuration; retries and pilot retained; no job-name parameter
reserved_delivery: one whole-index integrity pass, three primary real catalogue ranks, three query preparations, one validated processing/query reuse, comparison and final playback
scope: B02 only; no global stem index, refinement, model training, pitch tuning, human ratings or deployment
